comment: Runtime index of the package: the ONLY file /play fetches first.
card.json stays the Plaza storefront (title, copy, trailer, action);
this file is the runtime half — what assets exist and where their
manifests live. Component URLs are resolved through the per-asset
manifests, so the engine never hardcodes a package-internal path.
All paths are RELATIVE to the package baseUrl (catalog.json), so the
package can be republished from a CDN with a one-field catalog change.
'worker' is the reserved slot for the per-session game-agent worker
THE ONE RULE: package code never calls browser APIs (no DOM, canvas,
WebGL, Maps, Cesium, fetch). Packages emit JSON messages ({type, ...});
the static engine alone translates them into browser API calls. See
dev/README.md for the audit grep and the dev-harness exception.
